chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Chunk_01 (10/10 EXECUTED, diagnostic-only) shows Mode2 Donchian fresh-impulse + expanding ATR + rising mid-band ADX as non-modal: only 007-E005-P246 cleanly matches and pays near-full target. Modal path is ~75m time-stop partial R among mixed fade/chase anatomies; three adverse-selection losers (late chase, false breakout, counter-structure long) plus one mild stochastic red. Offline ADX frequently flat/falling at decision, weakening gate fidelity. No promotion authority.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Time-stop partial R harvest (truncated geometry)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Five winners/partial paths realize only ~0.12–0.37R via ~75m hold; TP 1.6R almost never reached. Dominant economic path is timeout clip, not impulse completion.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Late/exhausted channel chase or false breakout (adverse selection)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries after already-completed legs or at upper-channel resistance with non-rising/falling offline ADX. E007 hits near-full SL; E002/E003 print small reds.

ranked_mechanisms.label: True Mode2 Donchian fresh-impulse with expanding ATR/ADX
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Only E005 shows clean downside initiation + elevated/expanding offline ADX/ATR and near-full TP (+1.42R). Mechanism is rare in this sample, not modal.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Post-extension fade short (not lower-band initiation)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: SELL fills often short elevated structure after stretch, not fresh Donchian downside breakouts — Mode2 label overstates initiation purity.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Counter-structure / counter-EMA long
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Buys against declining EMA50 / down-day structure: E006 tiny green bounce, E009 mild red before later path continuation.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: First-touch envelope initiation vs already-extended run separation
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define impulse as first closed-bar exit beyond a sealed N-bar high/low envelope with limited prior excursion in the breakout direction; treat mid-leg channel rides as a different class (chase), not Mode2 initiation.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Splits initiation vs chase into a new structural definition; does not tune ADX/ATR thresholds, session/year vetoes, BE/trail, or timeout from this readout.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: EMA-slope and multi-hour range location concurrence at entry
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require direction to agree with closed-bar EMA50 slope and position relative to the sealed multi-hour mid-range (longs only above rising mid-range; shorts only below falling), so bounce/fade hybrids are excluded from the impulse lane.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Adds price-structure concurrence known at decision; not a post-hoc hour/day/year veto or parameter rescue of 007 economics.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Separate fade-from-extension short class from lower-band impulse short
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Hypothesis that SELL edge, if any, lives in first lower-band breaks with rising ADX (E005-like), whereas upper-channel fade shorts (E001/E008/E010) are a distinct process with different expectancy and should be preregistered separately or killed.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Creates a new falsifiable class split; forbids merging fade winners into Mode2 success narrative or retuning stops/targets to keep 007 alive.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. In chunk_02 the hypothesized Donchian fresh-impulse + expanding ATR + rising mid-band ADX mechanism is cleanly realized once (E012 near-full target). Dominant anatomy is late/exhausted or counter-structure fills plus 75m time-exit scrapes (8/10 TIME_EXIT_LIKE); worst single path is DI-conflict catch-knife stop-like loss E018. Sample cannot promote, go live, or authorize economic claims.

ranked_mechanisms.label: 75m time-exit scrape / incomplete path capture
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Eight of ten trades are TIME_EXIT_LIKE: price rarely reaches 1.6R TP; outcomes cluster in small R (+0.15 to -0.41) from hold-time cap rather than full stop/target geometry. Only E012 is near-full target; only E018 is stop-like.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Late or exhausted impulse entry (ADX peak-then-fade / extension chase)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries often occur after the impulsive leg already printed: ADX offline is peaking or declining, price is at channel extension, and 'fresh initiation' is not visually first-break quality.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Adverse selection / counter-structure or counter-DI fill
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Losers cluster on sells into support/up-context, range false breaks, mid-range non-displacement buys, downtrend bounce buys, and the DI-conflict catch-knife buy (E018).

ranked_mechanisms.label: True fresh Donchian + rising mid ADX + expanding ATR follow-through
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Only E012 simultaneously shows first-break structure, rising mid-band ADX, expanding ATR, DI alignment, and near-full 1.43R target path. Mechanism under review is rare in this chunk sample.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Stop-like loss after breakdown catch-knife
ranked_mechanisms.finding: E018 alone tags near initial SL (-0.90R) after buying into a DI-dominant dump; post-exit reversal is path context only, not a missed-profit claim.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: First-break-after-ADX-trough impulse only
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define eligible Donchian break as the first closed-bar extreme after a local ADX trough (rising from low), forbidding entries when offline/MT5 ADX is already post-peak or rolling over on an extended channel.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: This redefines initiation timing as a new structural state machine, not a post-hoc nudge of InpADX threshold, session veto, or BE/trail/timeout rescue of 007.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Hard DI-side concordance at decision bar
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require DI+ > DI- for BUY and DI- > DI+ for SELL on the closed decision bar as a binary concordance gate, independent of ADX level tuning.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Binary side-concordance is a new eligibility rule class; it is not threshold retuning of existing mid-band ADX or cost/session filters learned from this run's readout.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Displacement-from-midrange requirement
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require closed-bar close beyond Donchian extreme with minimum distance from mid-channel/EMA location so mid-range and shallow-break fills are ineligible by construction.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: This is a geometric initiation definition for a child hypothesis, not year/direction veto, not BE/trailing/timeout rescue, and not in-place rescue of 007..010 thresholds.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Mode2 fires mixed phases: true compression→impulse wins coexist with late-chase and counter-DI SL; time-exit dominates R. Diagnostic only.

ranked_mechanisms.label: time_exit_truncation_dominates_R
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Five trades end ~75m time-exit with small/partial R; path often unfinished vs SL/TP geometry.

ranked_mechanisms.label: late_or_chase_not_fresh_impulse
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries after move already spent or in chop; ADX rolling off — fails Mode2 fresh-impulse thesis.

ranked_mechanisms.label: compression_base_fresh_impulse_works
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Base/reclaim then displacement reaches near full target; intended Donchian+ATR expansion anatomy.

ranked_mechanisms.label: counter_DI_or_midrange_adverse_SL
ranked_mechanisms.finding: E027 sells into +DI bounce for fast SL; E021 late long fades to SL — adverse selection.

ranked_mechanisms.label: post_rejection_fade_partial_win
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Sells after rally stall capture partial downside; more continuation after time-exit visible.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Compression-base first-expansion only
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Allow entry only after multi-bar ATR compression then first directional Donchian expansion with ADX rising from a low base (E024/E025 anatomy).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: New structural phase definition of initiation; not retuning Mode2 ADX/ATR thresholds from 007 readout.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: ADX-cycle phase gate (rising-only)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require ADX rising from mid/low; forbid when ADX already peaked and is declining from elevated (spent impulse).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Binary ADX-phase state, not a post-hoc numeric threshold tweak on failed 007 gates.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: DI-alignment with impulse side
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require DI dominant on trade side at decision; block sells into +DI bounce / buys under -DI cascade (E027/E026).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Directional DI concurrence is a new eligibility axis, not session/year veto or BE/timeout rescue.

ranked_mechanisms.label: time_exit_partial_capture_of_impulse
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Four 75m holds monetize only a fraction of the 1.6R geometry (+0.24R to +0.82R). Paths often remain open-directionally valid after exit; this is exit-timing truncation of impulse, not necessarily entry invalidity (except E037 structure).

ranked_mechanisms.label: clean_donchian_fresh_impulse_continuation_to_target
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Three winners show aligned structure: Donchian/location break, expanding body/ATR, and rapid displacement into TP zone (+1.12R to +1.59R). These are the only cases that cleanly match the stated Mode-2 mechanism anatomy.

ranked_mechanisms.label: adverse_selection_counterstructure_or_late_or_range_entry
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries that are mid-range/countertrend (E033, E037), late bounce into supply (E039), or range-fade with declining ADX (E040) dominate non-clean outcomes. E037 still won via V-reversal, proving path luck can mask bad structure.

ranked_mechanisms.label: adx_slope_mismatch_at_decision
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Offline ADX is rolling/declining or non-accelerating at several poor entries, contrary to the hypothesis's 'rising mid-band ADX' claim. This is indicator-shape inference only (not CopyBuffer parity).

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: With-trend Donchian break only after closed-bar swing displacement
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define entry as closed M5 break of prior swing high/low in the Donchian-break direction with same-direction body expansion, explicitly excluding bounce/reclaim entries near the opposite band (the E033/E037/E039 family).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: This is a new structural eligibility family, not a post-hoc ADX/ATR/session/time-exit threshold tweak on failed 007 outcomes.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Hard ADX first-difference rising gate (shape, not level)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require ADX(t)-ADX(t-k)>0 over a fixed closed-bar window at decision, formalizing 'rising mid-band ADX' as a slope condition. E040-type declining-ADX range fades would be excluded by construction.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Does not retune a level learned from this readout; it makes an already-claimed shape condition falsifiable as a fresh child prereg.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Separate capitulation-reclaim mode from fresh-impulse mode
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Treat post-cascade V-bounce longs (E037 anatomy) as a distinct generative process from upper/lower Donchian impulse initiation; probe reclaim quality only under its own sealed contract, never mixed into Mode-2 impulse scoring.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Splits mechanisms rather than rescuing 007 with BE/trail/timeout/session vetoes or direction filters.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Chunk_05 (10/10 EXECUTED images opened): Donchian Mode-2 impulse is conditionally real when entry is a true post-compression band expansion with rising ADX/ATR and HTF alignment (E045, E042; E046 wins but impulse largely post-fill). Losses cluster on late-extension buys (E047, E043), counter-structure sell into residual bull (E041), and mid-range/compression non-impulses (E044, E050). TIME_EXIT_LIKE appears in 6/10 cases — path often partial scrape/harvest, not pure TP geometry. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (98%<99%); no promotion, no post-hoc rescue of 007.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Late-impulse / post-extension entry (exhaustion)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries after already-printed expansion (late buy into Donchian upper after climb, or sell into residual bull) dominate hard and soft losers. E047 is textbook: ADX peaking then declining, reverse to SL in <16m. E043 time-scrapes; E041 sells unfinished bull structure.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Aligned Donchian fresh-impulse + expanding ATR/ADX continuation
ranked_mechanisms.finding: When entry coincides with post-compression band expansion and HTF alignment, path reaches ~+0.8R to +1.17R (E045 best; E042 near-TP time exit; E046 cascade to TP though ADX expansion largely post-fill). Mechanism is conditionally real, not uniformly present.

ranked_mechanisms.label: TIME_EXIT_LIKE path dominance (partial harvest / scrape)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: 6/10 cases are TIME_EXIT_LIKE at 75m (or near). Winners often partial displacement (E048 +0.49R before reverse; E049 +0.14R grind) rather than clean TP hits; losers scrape near-flat (E043, E050). Exit-class geometry competes with signal edge.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Mid-range / compression non-impulse adverse selection
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries without a decision-time new-extreme band break (mid-channel fade E044; compression buy E050; mid-leg grind E049) produce either hard SL (E044) or near-zero time outcomes.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Post-entry impulse materialization (anticipatory fill)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: E046 wins large, but decision-time offline ADX/ATR are soft; cascade develops after fill. Distinguishes true pre-entry impulse gate from luck on subsequent breakdown.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Fresh-impulse = first band-extreme bar after multi-bar compression, not mid-trend re-touch
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define initiation as close at/beyond Donchian extreme only after a measured compression window (narrow channel / low body median), with HTF slope alignment. Exclude late re-entries on already-extended legs and mid-channel fades.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Re-specifies the initiation event geometry as a new preregistered structural definition; does not retune ADX/ATR thresholds, session filters, or SL/TP on 007 outcomes.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Separate pre-entry ADX/ATR expansion from post-fill cascade luck
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require expanding ATR and rising mid-band ADX on closed bars strictly before entry; treat post-entry ADX spikes as outcome path only. Test whether expectancy survives when anticipatory fills like E046 are excluded.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Is a fidelity/feature-timing hypothesis about when gates must be known; not BE, trailing, timeout, or direction veto on the failed family.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Decompose expectancy by exit class: TP-hit displacement vs 75m TIME_EXIT partials
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Prereg a child readout that splits R by exit class before claiming Donchian-impulse edge. If net edge is dominated by timeout partials (E048/E049) rather than completed 1R impulses, the active mechanism is hold-window harvesting, not fresh-impulse breakout edge.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Diagnostic decomposition of path contribution only; explicitly forbids converting the finding into timeout/BE/trailing parameter rescue of 007.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Chunk_06 is EXECUTED-only (no near-misses). Dominant anatomy is TIME_EXIT under-harvest/premature clip (6/10) plus three clear adverse-selection losers (range short E054; counter-structure long E057; fade unfinished bull E058). The sole clean intended-mechanism win is E055 near-full target after a base break. Conditional success exists, but most fills either enter after/against the impulse or exit by hold-window before geometry pays. Entire sample remains DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (98%<99% history quality) and cannot promote, go live, or authorize economic claims. No threshold/session/BE/trailing/timeout rescue of 007 is warranted from this chunk.

ranked_mechanisms.label: TIME_EXIT_UNDERHARVEST_OR_PREMATURE_CLIP
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Six of ten executed cases are TIME_EXIT_LIKE (75m hold modal). Several are correct-side or mild-path trades where fixed hold either (a) banks only a fraction of available R (E051/E052/E053/E059) or (b) exits before the impulse pays, producing scratch/near-scratch while later path continues (E056). This is exit-horizon anatomy, not proof that lengthening timeout would rescue 007.

ranked_mechanisms.label: ADVERSE_SELECTION_COUNTER_STRUCTURE_OR_RANGE
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Three losers show entry quality failure at decision: E054 shorts inside a non-directional box; E057 buys mid lower-high decline; E058 shorts a still-strong unfinished bull impulse. These are bad selection, not normal stop noise of clean fresh-impulse setups.

ranked_mechanisms.label: LATE_POST_IMPULSE_OR_FADE_OF_SPENT_EXPANSION
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries occurring after the visual impulse peak (large retracement of the expansion, or fade of residual trend) dominate mixed/weak outcomes. Contrasts with E055 base-break near-target win.

ranked_mechanisms.label: FRESH_BASE_BREAK_IMPULSE_PAYS_GEOMETRY
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Only one case (E055) cleanly matches intended Donchian fresh-impulse + expansion path and reaches near-full 1.6R. Conditional success template, not population edge under 98% history quality.

ranked_mechanisms.label: FAILED_MARGINAL_BREAKOUT_NEAR_SCRATCH
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Upper-range marginal buy fails without large R damage; timeout keeps loss small. Separates soft stochastic failure from hard adverse-selection losers.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Impulse-recency structural initiation (not late-chase)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: New child mechanism: allow Donchian expansion entries only when the break bar is still the active channel extreme and price has not already retraced a large fraction of the impulse range (structural recency of the expansion episode). Target late-post-impulse entries like E053 and fade-of-spent-expansion shorts like E058 while preserving base-break winners like E055.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Does not retune InpSignalMode=2 ADX/ATR thresholds, session/year/direction vetoes, or BE/trailing/timeout of 007. Requires a fresh preregistered structural definition and diagnostic re-test.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Anti-counter-structure / unfinished-impulse ban
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Forbid entries whose side opposes the signed active Donchian expansion episode while that episode's extreme remains the channel extreme (no shorting residual bull expansions; no buying mid lower-high declines). Addresses E057/E058-class adverse selection as a binary structural veto of opposite-side initiation, not a soft ADX threshold nudge.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Not a post-hoc ADX/DI threshold rescue or session filter on 007 outcomes; it is a new signed-episode state rule that must be frozen before any rerun.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Range-box rejection before Donchian initiation
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require a minimum pre-break compression/identity of a range box (low overlap with prior impulse, failed probes contained) and reject entries that fire while price is still overlapping the interior of a multi-hour box without a decisive extreme break (E054/E060 class).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Defines a new range-identity feature for a new hyp; does not loosen or tighten existing 007 ADX mid-band gates from this readout, and does not invent timeout/BE management fixes.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Chunk_07 is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (98% history). All 10 cases EXECUTED. Modal path is TIME_EXIT_LIKE (8/10): economics often partial residual R, not clean 1.6R TP geometry. Adverse selection dominates losers and thin wins: late/exhausted impulse (E063/E065/E066), counter-trend buy (E068), mid-range chop short (E069). No near-miss or cadence-bottleneck cases in this chunk. Conditional mechanism support exists but is minority and non-promotable from this sample.

ranked_mechanisms.label: TIME_EXIT_LIKE_DOMINANT_PATH
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Eight of ten executed cases hold ~75m and realize via time-exit-like paths rather than clean hard-TP or early hard-SL. Wins are often partial residual R (0.07–1.44R); losses on this path include adverse bounce sells/buys (E065, E068). Modal anatomy is timeout economics, not pure 1.6R TP geometry.

ranked_mechanisms.label: LATE_OR_EXHAUSTED_IMPULSE_ADVERSE_SELECTION
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries fire after the impulse body is largely spent: ADX peaked/declining (offline viz), price already extended on Donchian extreme, or bounce-into-mature-trend. Outcomes: thin +0.075R (E063), −0.69R time loss (E065), −0.94R stop (E066). Core mismatch to 'fresh' impulse initiation.

ranked_mechanisms.label: CLEAN_FRESH_DONCHIAN_IMPULSE_WITH_EXPANDING_ATR_RISING_ADX
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Only two charts clearly show co-directional structure + expanding ATR + rising mid-band ADX at decision (E062 SELL continuation; E070 BUY post-V breakout). Both win with solid R (+1.44R, +0.61R). Mechanism can work conditionally but is minority of this chunk.

ranked_mechanisms.label: COUNTERTREND_OR_MIDRANGE_CHOP_ADVERSE_ENTRY
ranked_mechanisms.finding: E068 buys into declining EMA50/downtrend with falling ADX; E069 shorts mid-range chop without lower-band initiation. Both lose (−0.36R time, −0.82R stop). Selection quality failure, not random path after good impulse entry.

ranked_mechanisms.label: RANGE_BREAK_OR_REJECTION_PARTIAL_OR_DELAYED_FOLLOWTHROUGH
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries from reclaim/range-break/range-rejection rather than textbook first expansion. All three time-exit winners but quality mixed: small partial R (E061/E064) vs near-1R delayed follow-through (E067). Do not infer edge solely from positive net.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Impulse-freshness via closed-bar ADX slope / peak-distance, not level alone
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require ADX to be rising over a short closed-bar lookback (and not immediately post-peak) at Donchian fire, so entries align with initiation rather than exhaustion of an already-spent impulse.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Does not retune 007's fixed ADX mid-band threshold, session/year veto, BE/trail, or timeout from this readout; proposes a distinct freshness state variable for a new prereg/probe.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Extension/exhaustion distance reject before Donchian fire
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Reject Mode-2 fires when price is already highly extended from channel mid (or after a large realized impulse fraction of the Donchian width) so late lower/upper prints into bases are not treated as fresh initiation.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Not a post-hoc SL/TP/time-exit or direction veto on 007 outcomes; new structural distance feature that must be frozen pre-outcome in a child hypothesis.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Hard co-directional EMA50 + DI regime as separate mechanism family
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Only allow Donchian impulse entries when closed price and DI dominance are co-directional with EMA50 slope (block counter-trend bounce longs/shorts and mid-range DI-mixed fires).

ranked_mechanisms.label: adverse_selection_false_or_counterstructure_impulse
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Four losers share weak or inverted structure: late/exhausted breakout long (E072), dead-ADX mid-range short (E075), counter-EMA downtrend long (E076), and V-recovery fade short (E077). Donchian/mode-2 fires without true fresh directional initiation; paths go near full-R stops, often with post-exit continuation against the entry.

ranked_mechanisms.label: time_exit_truncation_of_trend_or_partial_path
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Four trades hold ~75m with TIME_EXIT_LIKE tags. E071/E074 show genuine post-entry follow-through truncated before TP; E080 partial recovery capture; E073 scrapes near-zero on dead money. Cadence of fixed hold caps R on good paths without proving edge quality.

ranked_mechanisms.label: stale_or_midtrend_not_fresh_initiation
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Several entries occur after the impulse is already extended (post-rally high chop E073/E078), mid multi-hour grind (E074), or mid-recovery reclaim (E080). Offline ADX often declining or already elevated rather than rising from mid-band compression—suggests mode-2 'fresh impulse' is poorly discriminated from continuation/stale breaks.

ranked_mechanisms.label: true_fresh_impulse_working_anatomy
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Only E079 shows base→Donchian break with rising offline ADX/ATR and clean target capture (+1.35R). Demonstrates the intended mechanism can work conditionally, but is minority anatomy in this chunk and remains diagnostic-only.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Compression-to-expansion initiation only (block mid-trend continuation)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Treat valid Donchian impulse as first break after a pre-entry range compression / low-body regime, not a mid-grind continuation under already-trending EMA50 (contrast E079 base-break vs E074 multi-hour grind and E080 mid-recovery).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Defines a new structural state machine for entry eligibility; does not retune ADX/ATR thresholds, session vetoes, or BE/timeout exits on failed 007 outcomes.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Local structure alignment gate (trend-side only)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require entry side aligned with local structure (price vs EMA50 slope / swing sequence): block counter-structure longs under falling EMA and fade-sells into V-recovery strength (E076, E077) and mid-range shorts with dead vol (E075).
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: New confluence factor on closed-bar structure, not a post-hoc loss filter, hour veto, or stop/TP rescue of 007.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: ADX slope freshness (rising-only) as initiation discriminator
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Separate rising mid-band ADX at decision (E079) from declining/stale ADX at breakout (E073, E075, E078) as a falsifiable freshness feature for a new hyp, measured offline first then preregistered—not as a rescue threshold on this run.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Would require a fresh hypothesis_id + frozen PROBE_PLAN before any threshold choice; explicitly forbids fitting cutoffs from this diagnostic readout or amending 007 in-place.

chunk_findings.chunk_verdict: Chunk_09 (10/10 EXECUTED, all images opened) shows Mode-2 Donchian fresh-impulse frequently firing as mid-range bounce, late fade, or counter-DI mean-reversion rather than DI-aligned channel breakout. Seven cases classify as bad_entry/adverse_selection; zero clean normal-stochastic good-setup losses; zero near-misses; zero cadence bottlenecks. The two large winners (E084 +1.41R, E088 +1.51R) are counter-DI extreme mean-reversions that accidentally work — they do not validate the claimed aligned-impulse mechanism. Five time-exit-like paths show incomplete follow-through after late/mid-range initiation. Entire chunk remains DIAGNOSTIC ONLY under 98% history quality; no promotion, live, or economic authority.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Counter-DI / residual-structure entry (trade direction opposes offline DI dominance or residual trend)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Six of ten decisions fire with offline DI still opposed to trade side (or residual HTF bias opposed). Two of those became large winners via mean-reversion from extremes (E084, E088); four became losses/time-exit losses (E085, E087, E089, E090). Mode-2 mid-band ADX + expanding ATR alone does not enforce directional DI/structure alignment for a true fresh-impulse claim.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Adverse selection: mid-channel bounce / V-recovery misread as fresh Donchian impulse
ranked_mechanisms.finding: BUY lower-Donchian bounces into continuing declines (E082, E087) and SELL into post-flush V-recovery (E083) produce near-full or half-R stop losses quickly. These are wrong-side location selections relative to the active swing, not failed good impulses.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Time-exit incomplete follow-through / late or mid-range initiation
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Five of ten holds close at the 75m time-exit-like boundary with |R| << 1. Paths show chop around entry after late/mid-range initiation (impulse spent or never displaced). Includes one micro-winner (E081 +0.089R) and four small-to-moderate losses. Not evidence to lengthen timeout — that would be post-hoc rescue.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Counter-DI extreme mean-reversion wins (not DI-aligned impulse)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Both NEAR_FULL_TARGET winners (+1.41R SELL from highs, +1.51R BUY from lows) succeed as mean-reversion from Donchian extremes while offline DI still opposes the trade. They do not validate Mode-2 as an aligned fresh-impulse engine; they show a different edge class that Mode-2 sometimes accidentally captures.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Spent-impulse / late-fade initiation
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries after the expansion leg has already printed (ATR compressing or ADX rolling; price mid-channel). Result is grind/flat rather than impulse continuation — consistent with initiation timing after the statistical edge window closed.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: DI-aligned Donchian displacement initiation (hard directional DI agreement at decision)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require trade side to match offline/MT5 DI dominance at the closed decision bar AND a same-bar or prior-bar Donchian extreme displacement (close beyond prior Donchian boundary), not mid-channel bounce. Mid-band rising ADX remains secondary confirmation only.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: This is a new structural gate architecture (DI alignment + true breakout location), not retuning ADX/ATR/Donchian thresholds on failed 007 outcomes, not session/year/direction veto, and not BE/trail/timeout rescue.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Anti-rebound location filter: forbid lower/upper band bounces against active swing
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define a fresh-impulse location class that rejects lower-Donchian BUY bounces inside descending swing sequences and upper-area SELLs that fire during post-flush V-recoveries (reclaim after deep expansion). Probe would score location relative to last swing MSS/BOS, not a numeric ADX tweak.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: New location/path-class hypothesis with pre-registered acceptance geometry; not a post-hoc stop-distance or threshold rescue of Mode-2 007.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: HTF agreement required for M5 fresh-impulse (M15/H1 closed-bar direction co-sign)
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Only allow Mode-2 M5 initiation when M15 and/or H1 closed structure (EMA slope or last closed swing) agrees with trade direction. Residual HTF counter-bias appears repeatedly on losing counter-trend entries.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Adds a higher-timeframe confluence factor as a new preregistered hypothesis surface; does not veto hours/days/years from this readout or retune 007's mid-band ADX/ATR numbers.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Adverse selection: counter-structure or late-exhaustion entry (ADX/ATR not rising)

ranked_mechanisms.label: Range / mid-band false impulse (weak DI separation, flat ATR)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Entries inside congestion without clean Donchian escape; overlapping DI and non-expanding ATR. Outcomes: small time-exit scratch (E093) or near-full stop then post-exit run (E099).

ranked_mechanisms.label: Textbook mode-2 fresh impulse (Donchian break + rising mid ADX + expanding ATR)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: When all three visual conditions co-align with HTF direction, path delivers +0.81R to +1.14R. Mechanism can work; edge problem is selection purity, not absence of any winners.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Time-exit partial harvest of genuine impulse
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Four winners tagged TIME_EXIT_LIKE with 75.0m hold; R captured 0.55–1.06 without full 1.6R band. Not a failure mode here but shows hold-clock truncates geometric upside on working impulses.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Stop-then-run whipsaw (SL hit, delayed original-direction move)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: After adverse stop, price later moved in the intended direction. Suggests timing/location noise and stop geometry interaction, not necessarily wrong macro direction forever — still adverse at decision bar.

ranked_mechanisms.label: Late-stage high-ADX impulse (already mature trend)
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Positive SELL but ADX already elevated pre-entry; 'fresh initiation' weaker. Partial time-exit R. Secondary pattern, not chunk-dominant.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Impulse only after closed-bar EMA50 reclaim + DI separation persistence
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require Donchian break to coincide with closed-bar price on correct side of EMA50 and multi-bar DI lead (DI+>DI- for buys, reverse for sells) so counter-structure entries like E094/E096/E097 are structurally ineligible before ADX/ATR gates.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: ADX slope-positive initiation vs level-only mid-band
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Define 'rising mid-band ADX' as positive closed-bar ADX slope at decision (and disallow entries when ADX is rolling over from a prior peak), targeting the visual failure mode where high ADX level is misread as initiation (E094, E097) while slope-rising cases (E095, E100) succeed.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Range-compression veto via ATR slope + Donchian width state

ranked_mechanisms.label: Non-trend / residual-bull short (range or post-spike)

ranked_mechanisms.label: Near-TP then V-reversal to full SL

ranked_mechanisms.label: Valid strong-trend pullback long (time-exit partial win)

ranked_mechanisms.label: adverse_selection_non_squeeze_or_late_entries
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Largest losses cluster where entry is not a clean closed-bar envelope break after true compression: blowoff BUY chase (E003, -0.93R quick SL), rebound SELL (E001, -0.80R SL), post-spike range SELL (E006, -0.70R time loss), and exhausted late downtrend SELL into base (E009, -1.02R SL). These are structural selection failures of mode-4 anatomy as observed on charts.

ranked_mechanisms.label: time_exit_dominated_small_R_paths
ranked_mechanisms.finding: 7/10 cases carry TIME_EXIT_LIKE (or 75m hold) with |net_R| mostly <<1. Even the 'good' trend short (E004) and micro winners (E002, E008) never realize full 1.6R geometry before timeout. Modal economic path is small R around zero after costs, not clean stop/target resolution of a breakout impulse.

ranked_mechanisms.label: expansion_or_elevated_width_at_entry_not_true_compression
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Offline BB width/ATR panels frequently show elevated or recently spiked width at decision rather than multi-bar deep compression then break. E003 is pure expansion climax. This challenges fidelity of the stated mechanism 'compression followed by envelope breakout' on these executed samples (viz-only, not MT5 parity).

ranked_mechanisms.label: trend_aligned_continuation_can_look_ok_but_R_clipped
ranked_mechanisms.finding: When structure is multi-hour trend with price on the correct side of EMA34 (E004 best example), entry quality improves; residual issue is hold/target realization (time exit +0.16R while post-exit path continued) or lateness (E007 small loss). Not a rescue signal—only contrasts adverse-selection cases.

ranked_mechanisms.label: counter_trend_or_mid_range_fades_as_noise
ranked_mechanisms.finding: Buys after selloff basing (E008) or post-spike mean-reversion (E005) and mid-range sells (E010) produce micro wins/losses under time exit without breakout impulse. Consistent with low-expectancy noise under mode-4 when directional expansion is absent.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: True multi-bar compression-state gate before envelope break
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Require a sealed, closed-bar compression state (e.g. BB width/ATR in a lower historical percentile for N bars) immediately before the breakout bar; forbid entries when width/ATR are at expansion climax or still elevated mid-spike. Targets the observed blowoff-chase and post-spike entries (E003, E006, parts of E001).

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Exhaustion / late-leg filter on one-way extensions
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Block mode-4 breakouts when price is already multi-ATR extended from session open or after a long one-way leg with collapsing ADX (late short into base). Addresses E009 full stop and late E007-style extension shorts; orthogonal to raw squeeze width.
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.why_not_rescue: Fresh falsifiable mechanism (extension+energy decay), not post-hoc hour/day veto or stop-management rescue of the failed 009 campaign.

fresh_hypothesis_candidates.title: Directional regime concurrence for breakout mode
fresh_hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Only allow envelope breakouts when EMA34 slope and ADX/DI agree with breakout direction and price is not mid-BB range (avoid mid-range fades and counter-trend bounces labeled as 'breakouts'). Contrasts E004-like aligned cases with E005/E008/E010 noise.
